folds.selection_basis: Outcome-independent SHA-256 ordering of selected CAS subdataset/event names before archive extraction or label inspection.

protected_test_accesses.access: One image, binary mask, and display-label file were opened solely to verify array shapes, dtypes, and mask values before loader implementation.
protected_test_accesses.disposition: Wenchuan was removed from protected testing and reassigned to development before any model fit. Previously uninspected Moxi-UAV-1m replaced it.

folds.deviation_note: The original hash allocation placed Wenchuan in protected testing. A semantic-loader access occurred before model fitting, so Wenchuan was fail-closed into development and the previously uninspected Moxi-UAV-1m event was moved to protected testing.
